authority.evaluation_requires: an Owner-merged program charter at charters/programs/A1B-QUALIFICATION-1.json (CEA-1 section 12) binding this file's sha256; not created by this preregistration
authority.merge_order: #82 verification law -> #83 Owner research authority -> #84 this preregistration -> A1B-QUALIFICATION-1 charter
authority.verification_law_precedence: the law as merged on main governs; where it and this file state different numbers for the same test, the stricter applies; the law must be merged before any evaluation

baselines.A1B_BENCH: same universe, sizing and band rule as V1, always long (timing off) — the matched benchmark
baselines.BTC_HOLD: BTC/USDT buy and hold, same costs
baselines.EXPOSURE_MATCHED_PASSIVE: A1B_BENCH scaled to V1's realised average gross exposure (report only)

citations: Liu, Tsyvinski and Wu (2022), Common Risk Factors in Cryptocurrency, Journal of Finance
Liu and Tsyvinski (2021), Risks and Returns of Cryptocurrency, Review of Financial Studies
Han, Kang and Ryu, Time-Series and Cross-Sectional Momentum in the Cryptocurrency Market (working paper)
Moskowitz, Ooi and Pedersen (2012), Time Series Momentum, Journal of Financial Economics
Bailey and Lopez de Prado (2014), The Deflated Sharpe Ratio, Journal of Portfolio Management
Bailey, Borwein, Lopez de Prado and Zhu (2017), The Probability of Backtest Overfitting, Journal of Computational Finance

costs.base_fee_composition: 0.10% Binance spot taker fee + 0.05% slippage allowance (same base as A1/FCS-1)

data.holdout_extension: a separate lock covering 2026-09-01T00:00:00Z to 2027-01-01T00:00:00Z, built by the same acquisition route only after 2027-01-01T00:00:00Z, checksum-verified, under the Owner record's data-preparation scope
data.source: Binance public archive data.binance.vision, every zip verified against its published .CHECKSUM (research/auth2/archive.py)
data.survivorship: point-in-time membership; delisted symbols retained and force-exited at their last kline

declared_changes_from_a1: universe capped to point-in-time U6 ranks 1..4 (sleeves = 4) for retail-size feasibility
no-trade band with a minimum-order floor (rebalance_rule below)
nothing else: lookbacks, target_vol, vol_window, decision time, data, costs and engine are A1's
drawdown_note: A1's 18.8% max drawdown is low against published long-only TSMOM drawdowns (about 60%, Han, Kang and Ryu); with sleeve sizing capped at 1/sleeves and a 25% per-sleeve vol target, low portfolio vol is expected by construction; E10 must show it with the realised vol and drawdown/vol ratio rather than assume it

gates.E0_DATA: Dataset V3 lock verifies; holdout extension lock verifies; min_notional_usdt snapshot recorded
gates.E10_SAMPLE_PERIOD: delta Sharpe vs A1B_BENCH > 0 in >= 4 of the 7 calendar years 2019-2025; no single year contributes > 60% of the summed yearly log return; realised annual vol and max-drawdown/vol ratio reported; TOO_GOOD flag (max DD < 0.5 x A1B_BENCH max DD AND CAGR >= A1B_BENCH CAGR) forces an Owner review before any paper preparation
gates.E11_HOLDOUT: opened once after E0-E10 pass; reject-only: REJECTED if V1 net <= 0 AND delta Sharpe vs A1B_BENCH <= 0; otherwise reported as UNDERPOWERED (about 4 months cannot confirm an edge)
gates.E1_CAUSALITY: signals.lookahead_check (20 cuts) and signals.recursive_check (shifts 30/90, warm-up 400 d) on V1 and A1B_BENCH generators: 0 failures; Freqtrade lookahead-analysis and recursive-analysis on the engine strategy: 0 flagged signals
gates.E2_PARITY: Freqtrade 2026.7 vs frozen replay, V1@base development: daily-return correlation >= 0.999 and |total-return difference| <= 0.0025
gates.E3_FEASIBILITY: G3 re-applied: >= 95% of V1@base development fills have notional >= max(5 USDT, min_notional_usdt) at the 1000 USDT wallet; the 100 USDT wallet share is reported; the live-vs-replay 30-day match is NOT_YET_EVALUABLE until paper
gates.E4_PAPER_GUARD: engine config passes engine_io.guard_config; dry_run = true
gates.E5_SCREEN: development, V1: R1 net > 0 and Sharpe > 0 at base; R2 net > 0 at x2; R3 net > 0 at +1 bar; R4 Sharpe(V1) - Sharpe(A1B_BENCH) > 0; R5 max drawdown <= 0.50; R6 validation reject-only: NOT (net <= 0 AND delta Sharpe <= 0)
gates.E6_ROBUSTNESS: reject V1 if 2 or more of V2-V4 have development Sharpe <= 0 or delta Sharpe vs their own matched bench <= 0
gates.E7_PBO: CSCV with S = 16 blocks over the daily net returns (development + validation) of the matrix {A1 primary, A1 P1-P5, V1-V4} (10 columns): PBO <= 0.05 (hard gate; PROFITABILITY-VERIFICATION-LAW-1 section 4.1, Owner decision OD-1: A1b is a new research program); NOT_EVALUABLE is never PASS
gates.E8_DSR: deflated Sharpe ratio of V1 daily net returns (development + validation) >= 0.95 with N = max(39, the law's N_eff); 39 = lifetime TLOS configurations 35 (OD-C5) + 4 A1b variants
gates.E9_EXPOSURE: delta Sharpe vs A1B_BENCH > 0 (material); Sharpe, CAGR, max drawdown vs BTC_HOLD, NO_TRADE and EXPOSURE_MATCHED_PASSIVE reported; reduced exposure is never called alpha

hypothesis: Long-only time-series momentum with per-sleeve volatility targeting on the most liquid point-in-time Binance USDT spot assets earns a higher risk-adjusted net return than the same book held always long, AND remains executable at retail size once trades below a minimum-order floor are suppressed by a declared no-trade band.

multiple_testing.across_candidates: per the verification law (Holm/BHY across concurrent candidates)

non_claims: no profitability is claimed; historical results are exploratory evidence only
PREPAPER_CANDIDATE is not paper admission and not a survivor decision
no part of this file authorizes execution, data download, paper or live trading

min_notional_usdt.if_missing: every evaluation step refuses to run (INCONCLUSIVE_INPUT_MISSING)
min_notional_usdt.source_rule: max over every symbol that is ever a rank 1..6 U6 member of the NOTIONAL (or MIN_NOTIONAL) filter minNotional in one GET /api/v3/exchangeInfo snapshot captured on the Owner host, its bytes sha256-recorded in the data-preparation PR, before any A1b evaluation; never chosen from a result

prospective_plan.alternative_s: chosen once in [0.50, 0.75] x V1's DSR-deflated historical Sharpe (N = max(39, N_eff)), declared at the paper preregistration
prospective_plan.binding_on: any later, separately authorized A1b paper preregistration; this file authorizes no paper or live step
prospective_plan.calibration: law section 6.4: A* = max over iid Gaussian, iid Student-t(3), GARCH(1,1)-t(3) (a 0.12, b 0.85) and a stationary block bootstrap (mean block >= 20) of V1's own development daily returns, >= 2000 paths each, recorded seeds; fresh-seed false acceptance <= alpha + 0.015; power >= 1 - beta - 0.03 or a longer truncation horizon; A* never below Wald's A
prospective_plan.evidence_class: PROSPECTIVE_PAPER only, from a T0 merged before the first included bar (law section 2)
prospective_plan.kill_rules: law section 7: SPRT lower bound, triple-penance drawdown / time-under-water bounds, operational kill
prospective_plan.multiple_testing: alpha / m with m fixed at the paper preregistration; Holm across concurrent candidates (law section 8)
prospective_plan.test: Wald SPRT on standardized net daily returns (law section 6.1); weekly aggregation declared if daily units are autocorrelated (law section 6.4 item 6)
prospective_plan.verdicts: law section 9 (Owner decision OD-2): Level A = NOT REFUTED, not proof of profitability, never live authorization; Level B = prospective statistical evidence under the frozen law; no real-money, live or scaling authority follows automatically from either level

rebalance_rule.entry: flat -> long only when target_notional >= min_order_floor; otherwise stay flat
rebalance_rule.exit: long -> flat always executes as a full close, whatever its size
rebalance_rule.resize: long -> long only when |target_weight - current_weight| >= max(band_fraction x target_weight, min_order_floor / equity); otherwise hold the drifted position

selection_debt_disclosure: A1's family N = 21 and lifetime TLOS N = 35 (OD-C5); A1's development and validation results (Sharpe 1.39, max DD 18.8%, delta Sharpe +0.203, G3 30.6%) were seen before this file; the rank cap and band were chosen because of G3, which is itself a post-result choice and is the reason the development and validation windows are labelled exploratory

signal.decision_time: every UTC day boundary, from daily closes known at that boundary (23:00 UTC 1h kline close)
signal.on_rule: sleeve is long when score > 0, else flat (cash)
signal.score: mean of the three trailing simple returns of the daily close

stop_rules: any frozen value, window, threshold or variant changed after any A1b result: the program is BURNED
a causality failure after its one retry: STOP
the holdout opened before E0-E10: BURNED
no new variant, parameter or hypothesis may be added after any result; a new idea is a new preregistration

terminal_states.INCONCLUSIVE: a material gate cannot be established honestly (missing input, insufficient coverage)
terminal_states.INVALID_RUN: an integrity or causality failure; one technical retry, then STOP
terminal_states.PREPAPER_CANDIDATE: every material gate E0-E11 passes; makes V1 eligible to be proposed for a separate Owner paper-admission decision, nothing more

universe.delisting: forced exits at a member's terminal kline, as in A1 (Dataset V3 keeps delisted symbols)

variants.rule: only V1 can become a candidate; V2-V4 can only reject it; no variant is ever substituted for V1

evidence_class.development: HISTORICAL_EXPLORATORY: the A1 primary was screened on it (FCS-1, 2026-10-17) and smoke-tested before AUTH-2
evidence_class.locked_holdout: HISTORICAL_UNSEEN for every A1-family configuration per repository and Lane A records; opened exactly once, after every development/validation gate; if any prior exposure is found it is BURNED and only prospective evidence can count
evidence_class.prospective: forward paper under a separate Owner authority, judged by the verification law; the only evidence class that can support a profitability claim
evidence_class.validation: HISTORICAL_EXPLORATORY: the A1 primary's secondary window was seen in FCS-1 R6
